name: Ibrat

queries.query: Ibrat Uzbekistan cadastral parcel map official land registry cadastral viewer
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Uzbekistan's National Geoportal (open.ngis.uz), the Cadastre Agency, and Digital Government documentation describing public land-parcel registry information. No Ibrat-specific anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official National Geoportal landing page; it advertises cadastral-number and map search, but the direct page request timed out from this environment.

Official Digital Government description says the National Geoportal provides public information about registered land parcels, including cadastral number, address, and use purpose; it does not expose a verified anonymous geometry API in the retrieved page.
Official Cadastre Agency notice states that open.ngis.uz was launched as a public geoportal for land parcels and real-estate objects.
Official open-data record identifies an institution in Ibrat shaharchasi, Buvayda tumani, Farg'ona viloyati; this supports locality identification, not parcel coverage.
Official open-data directory lists the Farg'ona regional land-resources/state-cadastre department and its public office metadata.
